title: CSCI 488 — CS Undergraduate Summer Co-op
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Students will define the minimum time and credit requirements for summer co-op registration.
Students will articulate the dual-document grading mechanism and consistency standard for co-op evaluation.
Students will apply ACM ethical principles and responsible research practices to professional co-op work.
